originBelt: Terai & Mid-Hill Winter Harvests (Chitwan, Dang & Kavre)
shelfLife: 12 months in its airtight glass jar
whatItIs: NaturesMud Flax Seeds (loved across Nepal as Alash / आलस) are triple-cleaned, glossy brown whole flax seeds packed in a 200 GM glass jar. Completely free from stones, soil grit, and chaff, Alash is a traditional Nepali superfood celebrated for its high plant-based Omega-3 fatty acids (ALA), soluble and insoluble mucilage fiber, and plant lignans.
nepaliKitchenUses: Traditional Nepali Alash ko Chhop (आलसको छोप): Dry-roast Flax Seeds in an iron pan until they crackle, then pound or grind with roasted garlic, timur (Sichuan pepper), dry red chili, and Himalayan Black Salt (Bire Noon) to serve with rice, dal, or boiled potatoes.

Freshly Ground Morning Omega-3 Booster: Lightly toast and grind 1 tablespoon of Flax Seeds into a coarse meal to stir into warm oats, dahi, or smoothies (grinding unlocks Omega-3 inside the hard seed coat).
High-Fiber Chapati & Bread Dough: Add 1–2 tablespoons of ground roasted Alash into whole-wheat atta for soft, nutty rotis.
Vegan Egg Replacer for Baking: Mix 1 tablespoon of ground Flax Seeds with 3 tablespoons of warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until gelatinous to replace 1 egg in cakes or pancakes.
whoItSuits: Ideal for Nepali households making authentic stone-free Alash ko Chhop, vegetarians seeking plant Omega-3, adults wanting daily soluble fiber, and home bakers.
monsoonStorage: Whole flax seeds stay fresh for up to 12 months in their sealed glass jar because the outer seed hull protects the delicate Omega-3 oils. Once you roast and grind them into powder, consume the ground powder within 1–2 weeks.

faqs.q: What is the price of Flax Seeds (आलस / Alash) in Nepal?

faqs.q: Should I eat Flax Seeds (आलस) whole or ground?
faqs.a: Whole flax seeds have a tough outer shell that can pass through digestion unbroken. For maximum Omega-3 and lignan absorption, lightly dry-roast the seeds until they pop and grind them into a powder (like Alash ko Chhop) or chew thoroughly.

faqs.q: Do I need to wash or pick stones out of NaturesMud Flax Seeds?
faqs.a: No! Our Flax Seeds are already triple-cleaned and sorted so you can dry-roast them directly from the glass jar without worrying about gritty stones.

faqs.q: How much Flax Seeds should I eat daily?
faqs.a: 1 tablespoon (about 10g to 12g) of roasted and ground Flax Seeds per day is the ideal daily portion.

faqs.q: How do I make quick Nepali Alash ko Chhop at home?
faqs.a: Dry-roast 1/2 cup of NaturesMud Flax Seeds on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes until they crackle and smell nutty. Cool completely, then pulse in a dry grinder with 1/2 tsp Bire Noon, roasted chili, and a pinch of timur.
